integrity: Proof is analytic and self-contained for the claimed inverse classification. No computation is asserted to prove infinitely many cases. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Positive invertible real-analytic weights on C(T) only; does not classify full operator spectra or general dynamics. The fixed-angle radius identity is known; publication priority for the inverse continuity-locus classification remains subject to external assessment.
title: Arithmetic classification and realization of spectral-radius discontinuities for positive weighted rotations
